paragraphs: Resh Lakish was so called by R' Yochanan, as explained in his entry.[^1]

notes.text: Yochanan’s title is abbreviated and retained as R'. He called Resh Lakish by the heading designation Bar Lakisha, not the reverse. Resh Lakish remains the supplied name without expanding Resh into a new rank; his entry is an unbound textual pointer.
